comparison.objective: Cut a pine board on a table saw using guarded feed hardware and leave the resulting pieces flat.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual straight feed, push-stick use, workpiece constraint, and blade-clearance control.
comparison.success_condition: Complete an on-line cut with pieces flat and still, hands clear, and no lifting, kick-up, table departure, or guard contact.
comparison.reason: This tests tool-mediated cutting and hazardous feed control. The candidate tests controlled screening and material retention; bimanual motion and damage avoidance are only generic shared primitives.
